about: changes made after the round-2 independent review, in response to its reservations

reservations_and_response.reservation: M-K escape: a transport-level refusal could answer by echoing the request bytes, and nothing in the suite noticed a credential frame coming back in an error reply
reservations_and_response.response: added IPC-PIPE-REFUSAL-NEVER-ECHOES-MATERIAL and IPC-PIPE-REFUSAL-STORES-NOTHING: a unique material is offered to a host that refuses the peer, and neither the reply nor the host directory may carry it in any encoding
reservations_and_response.verified_by_mutation: MK-refused-connection-echoes-request -> both ids plus IPC-SERVE-FOREIGN-PEER-REFUSED fail; suite restored

reservations_and_response.reservation: the chooser's return value is used verbatim, so an integrator that returns the client's hint would silently reopen the client-named-path hole
reservations_and_response.response: added WS-CHOOSER-RETURN-WINS-OVER-CLIENT-HINT and WS-BOUND-ROOT-IS-CHOSEN-DIRECTORY: the frame hints at a different directory on purpose, and both the reply's display_path and the registered root must name the directory the chooser returned

reservations_and_response.reservation: the review's M-N2 escape: replacing the DEFAULT peer lookup with a stub that always answers 'this same user' is not detectable on this machine
reservations_and_response.response: not fixable here. Every identity assertion the unprivileged harness can reach is present (OS-IDENTITY-NONEXISTENT-PID-UNRESOLVED, OS-IDENTITY-SYSTEM-PID-NOT-SELF, OS-IDENTITY-VERIFY-SELF, IPC-SERVE-FOREIGN-PEER-*), but proving that the default lookup is the real OS query rather than a constant requires a second interactive OS account. Carried as a W17-99 resource requirement for the formal cases A10/A11/C02/C22.

reservations_and_response.reservation: the review's M-O/M-O2 escape: the withdrawal closures for credential-import and workspace-choose replies are not exercised
reservations_and_response.response: no reachable input makes those two replies nonconformant today - only the bootstrap definition pins a value (protocol_version) a host can be misconfigured to violate. The bootstrap withdrawal is exercised, the other two are not. Recorded as an open gap rather than claimed as coverage.

reservations_and_response.reservation: the one-live-credential invariant is per host directory, so two host directories over one database can both hold a live credential
reservations_and_response.response: accepted as designed for this card and disclosed: the host revokes only the credential it issued in the same directory, because revoking another instance's token would be a cross-instance destructive action. Single-owner-instance enforcement belongs to the card that owns host startup and instance locking.

reservations_and_response.reservation: diskLeaks returns '<file>=<encoding-prefix>' and a prefix of the matched encoding can appear in a failure detail
reservations_and_response.response: the sentinel in the check source is a fixed fake, and the per-run material token is random; no evidence file in this receipt carries a credential value. The prefix form is kept because a bare filename would not say which encoding leaked. Reviewer confirmed no secret value reached any committed evidence file.

reservations_and_response.reservation: the retry disclosure said assertion outcomes 'must not depend on' the loopback behaviour, which overstated it: one run in ~11 still flipped two BOOT-HOST-CONFIGURE ids
reservations_and_response.response: the harness now warms the loopback connection once at startup (GET /healthz until ready, max 4s) before any assertion can depend on it, in addition to the transport-only retry. Three consecutive runs at 148 assertions and both neighbour regressions were clean afterwards; the underlying first-connect flakiness is a property of this machine, and the fix is disclosed rather than described as eliminated.

reservations_and_response.reservation: receipt.json pinned its own hash, which is necessarily stale
reservations_and_response.response: the artifact inventory no longer lists receipt.json itself; every other evidence file and every product source is pinned and re-hashable.

reservations_and_response.reservation: internal/api/v2.go, internal/domain/client_protocol_schema.go and internal/domain/v24_sessions.go are gofmt-dirty (files this card may not touch)
reservations_and_response.response: out of this card's write_scope and already accepted evidence of W03-01/W03-02, so they are left byte-identical. Carried as an obligation for the owning card.
